//: TODO(design): eggs and Broodlings in the lair (GAME_DESIGN.md §7, §12; M3). Working values and texts by Claude; change them freely. Eggs are laid in the lair for eggCost and wait there until the hydra tells one to hatch, which takes hatchTurns world turns. Each egg carries a random share of the mutations its mother has when she lays it (lineage.json inheritedShare, rounded up), a different one from the other eggs when it can. An unhatched egg is a candidate for the next generation, so every Broodling is one heiress fewer. A hydra hatches with startingEggs eggs already in her lair.

scouts.//: Broodlings that leave the lair and explore on their own: every world turn a scout walks movement points towards the nearest ground nobody has seen, and shows what it sees within sight hexes. It keeps clear of encounters; the Order's people kill a scout that ends a world turn next to them.

lostDefense.//: A lost battle for the lair: the Order breaks this share of the eggs (rounded up; 1 = all of them).

battle.//: TODO(design): Broodlings guarding the lair fight beside the hydra in the battle for it. Each stands on a hex round the body, walks to the nearest human and bites it; the Order hits them like heads in its way. Those that die are gone from the lair. Times in seconds, attack range in hexes.

texts.name: The swamp under the swamp
texts.text: Warm mud, old bones, and the smell of home. Old Mother Toad keeps an eye on the eggs, and the other eye on you.
texts.noEggs: No eggs. The lineage hangs by one neck.
texts.broodlings: Broodlings: {defenders} guarding the lair, {scouts} out scouting.
texts.rest: Sleep in the mud until morning (End Turn)
texts.hatchDefender: Hatch egg {n} to guard the lair
texts.laid: An egg is laid. The heads are briefly, uniformly proud.
texts.hatchingStarted: Egg {n} begins to hatch. Give it {turns} turns.
texts.hatched: An egg hatches. The Broodling is small, wet and already hungry, and takes up its post in the lair.
texts.hatchedScout: An egg hatches. The Broodling sniffs the air once and goes off to look around.
texts.scoutKilled: One of the scouts was caught by the Order. It did not tell them anything. It cannot talk.
texts.eggsBroken: The Order broke eggs in the lair: {n}.
texts.full: The lair has room for no more eggs.
texts.//: TODO(design): the Hidden Egg (GAME_DESIGN.md §12) can be hidden at any time for now; the design says 'when the lineage is doing well', which has no rule yet. Hiding takes the egg out of the lair, with the mutations it carries.
texts.hide: Ask Old Mother Toad to hide egg {n}
texts.hidden: Old Mother Toad takes the egg and waddles off into the dark. She comes back without it, and without an explanation.
texts.keptHidden: Old Mother Toad keeps one egg of the lineage hidden.
texts.alreadyHidden: Old Mother Toad already keeps one egg hidden. She will not say where.
